svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
Four-wire source-default selection: JP10 1–2 ties FORCE2 to GND; JP1 / JP2 remain open.
J3.1 FORCE+ → U1.8; J3.2 SENSE+ → U1.10; J3.3 SENSE- → U1.11; J3.4 FORCE- → U1.12.
Retained MAX31865 Rev3 pin table requires FORCE2 at ground for two-/four-wire operation, not FORCE+.
Source JP10 Bridged12 and JP1/JP2 Open footprints match this selection; verify actual assembly before connecting.
Pinned TemperatureControl factory has no MAX31865 driver. Do not substitute MAX31855 or thermistor settings.
For required support email wolf.arthur@gamil.com. No firmware RTD mode, bias, filter or calibration is invented.
J2/chain and other external contacts unused unless explicitly stated. Onboard circuit functions are not field wires.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.

svg.text: J2 chain / unused host GPIO disconnected.
Four separate leads reach the RTD element;
do not short sense/force leads at the board.
J3 source pitch 5.08 mm; depicted contact pitch 50 mm. Numbered electrical symbols are not physical mating faces.
Firmware driver, RTD calibration, matching P12 art, physical orientation and actual viewer remain OPEN.
